_note: Synthetic PSA-shaped data for the B-22 summary workflow (invented client, people and tickets). Generated by evals/summary/build_psa.py from the tenant users and the ticket files; no labels. Field names follow fixtures/psa/SOURCES.md; status values are placeholders (UNVERIFIED); affectedUserEmail is a local field, not an Autotask field (UNVERIFIED). Fixture-based, not a real PSA.

tickets.title: New Pixel, Authenticator came across empty
tickets.description: I upgraded to a new Pixel 9 over the weekend and the Authenticator app came across empty. I can't open email or the schedule at chairside.
